'''Chewbacca's quarters''' were an apartment on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] lived in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The apartment was situated in a building across from [[Sasal Center]], [[Wauth Complex]], and [[Ooe'b Towers]]. A door connected it to the [[Solos' apartment]]. In 8 ABY, Chewbacca's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] and his son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] visited him there.
